summary: The exact candidate fixes the stated item-key brace handling. An independently defined contract checker found no failure in 9,630 valid format strings, while the same checker found 1,967 baseline failures. Complete diff review found no weakened existing assertion, public signature change or foreseeable compatibility regression for supported format strings.
